summary: INQONLN is the online CICS main handler / driver for portfolio inquiry transactions. It runs a session loop that repeatedly receives a screen request (map INQMAP) and dispatches on a function code: MENU shows the menu screen, INQP links to the portfolio-inquiry program (INQPORT), INQH links to the history-inquiry program (INQHIST), and EXIT ends the session; anything else is an error. After dispatching, it performs a three-step security check (validate user -> authorize resource -> log access) via the SECMGR program, and on any security failure reports an error and returns. Errors are centralised through a shared error handler (ERRHNDL), which may force a CICS ABEND. Error conditions handled: unknown function code, CICS ERROR/PGMIDERR/NOTFND, and security-check failure.

paragraphs.name: MAINLINE
paragraphs.pseudocode:
CICS HANDLE CONDITION: on ERROR / PGMIDERR / NOTFND -> jump to P900-ERROR-ROUTINE
WHILE session is NOT terminated DO
  CALL P100-PROCESS-REQUEST
END WHILE
CICS RETURN TO caller

annotations.note: PERFORM ... UNTIL SESSION-TERMINATED is the pseudo-conversational session loop (test-before WHILE).

paragraphs.name: P100-PROCESS-REQUEST
paragraphs.pseudocode:
CLEAR WS-COMMAREA   -- MOVE LOW-VALUES
CICS RECEIVE MAP INQMAP (mapset INQSET) INTO WS-COMMAREA  RESP -> ws_response_code
SELECT CASE ws_commarea_function
  WHEN 'MENU': CALL P200-DISPLAY-MENU
  WHEN 'INQP': CALL P300-PORTFOLIO-INQUIRY
  WHEN 'INQH': CALL P400-HISTORY-INQUIRY
  WHEN 'EXIT': SET SESSION-TERMINATED = true
  ELSE:        CALL P900-ERROR-ROUTINE
END SELECT
CALL P050-SECURITY-CHECK
IF SEC-RESPONSE-CODE <> 0 THEN
  SET ws_error_message = SEC-ERROR-INFO
  CALL P900-ERROR-ROUTINE
  CICS RETURN TO caller
END IF

annotations.note: SME REVIEW: the security check runs AFTER the requested function has already been dispatched (P200/P300/P400), not before. Access is validated only after the action executes — a likely security-ordering flaw.

paragraphs.notes: The heart of the program: receive -> dispatch -> (post-)security-check.

paragraphs.name: P200-DISPLAY-MENU
paragraphs.pseudocode:
CICS SEND MAP INQMNU (mapset INQSET) ERASE  RESP -> ws_response_code
-- shows the inquiry menu screen

paragraphs.name: P300-PORTFOLIO-INQUIRY
paragraphs.pseudocode:
CICS LINK PROGRAM INQPORT  PASSING: WS-COMMAREA  RESP -> ws_response_code
-- delegates the portfolio position lookup to INQPORT

paragraphs.name: P400-HISTORY-INQUIRY
paragraphs.pseudocode:
CICS LINK PROGRAM INQHIST  PASSING: WS-COMMAREA  RESP -> ws_response_code
-- delegates the transaction-history lookup to INQHIST

paragraphs.name: P900-ERROR-ROUTINE
paragraphs.pseudocode:
SET ERR-PROGRAM = 'INQONLN'
SET ERR-PARAGRAPH = 'P900-ERROR-ROUTINE'
SET ERR-CICS-RESP = EIBRESP        -- CICS response codes from the exec interface block
SET ERR-CICS-RESP2 = EIBRESP2
SET ERR-WARNING = true
CICS LINK PROGRAM ERRHNDL  PASSING: WS-ERROR-AREA   -- central error handler
IF ERR-ABEND THEN
  CICS ABEND with code 'IERR'      -- terminate the transaction
END IF
SET ws_error_message = ERR-MESSAGE

annotations.note: EIBRESP / EIBRESP2 are CICS-supplied fields (Exec Interface Block) carrying the last command's response codes.

paragraphs.notes: Central error path; delegates to the shared ERRHNDL program and may force an ABEND.

paragraphs.name: P050-SECURITY-CHECK
paragraphs.pseudocode:
SET SEC-REQUEST-TYPE = 'V'        -- 'V' = validate user
CICS ASSIGN USERID -> SEC-USER-ID  -- get the signed-on user id
CICS LINK PROGRAM SECMGR  PASSING: WS-SECURITY-REQUEST
IF SEC-RESPONSE-CODE = 0 THEN                 -- user valid
  SET SEC-REQUEST-TYPE = 'A'       -- 'A' = authorize
  SET SEC-RESOURCE-NAME = 'INQONLN'
  SET SEC-ACCESS-TYPE = 'READ'
  CICS LINK PROGRAM SECMGR
  IF SEC-RESPONSE-CODE = 0 THEN               -- authorized
    SET SEC-REQUEST-TYPE = 'L'     -- 'L' = log access
    CICS LINK PROGRAM SECMGR
  END IF
END IF

annotations.note: CICS ASSIGN USERID retrieves the terminal operator's signed-on user id for the security check.

paragraphs.notes: Three-step security via SECMGR: validate user -> authorize resource -> log access. (See P100 note: this runs after dispatch.)

usage.note: Produced by Claude Code in-session; no API call, no key, no token cost.
